subject.title: Add auth sync command or auto-sync for API key rotation across agents

question: Should OpenClaw handle env-backed API-key rotation shadowing with an explicit operator-controlled repair/warning path, automatic auth-store sync on config/env writes, or runtime fallback after credential failure?
rationale: Each viable direction changes credential precedence, secret copying, or failure recovery across agent auth stores, which repository policy treats as security-, auth-provider-, and compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Operator-controlled repair and warning
options.body: Add a doctor/status/models-auth repair path that detects shadowed rotated keys and updates canonical SQLite auth stores only after explicit user action.

options.title: Automatic sync on config/env update
options.body: Propagate supported static keys into affected agent auth stores automatically, trading convenience for larger silent secret-copying blast radius.

options.title: Runtime fallback after auth failure
options.body: Try env/config credentials after a stored profile fails, trading recovery convenience for a more surprising auth precedence model.

recommendation.title: Operator-controlled repair and warning
recommendation.body: Add a doctor/status/models-auth repair path that detects shadowed rotated keys and updates canonical SQLite auth stores only after explicit user action.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history for auth storage, CLI surface, and runtime auth precedence points to steipete as the best routing owner for the credential-boundary choice.
